summary: The documents describe a reporting module responsible for generating reports in various formats using Crystal Reports and MigraDoc/PDFSharp. It includes workflows for handling report file selection, parameter setting, export processes, and error handling.
purpose: To generate and manage report creation and exportation in different formats based on user needs and system settings.

workflows.name: Run Report
steps: Set up login details and configure report file path.
Check for alternate language file if locale is set.
Load the report document and apply connection info.
Determine export format and export the report.
Handle errors during export or report loading.

workflows.name: MigraDoc XML Report
steps: Set path to XML template file.
Check for alternate language XML file if locale is set.
Load and execute the template using PdfXmlReader.
Render and save the PDF document using PdfDocumentRenderer.

business_rules: Use alternative language files if the session indicates so.
Reports are saved in the 'Reports' folder with a unique hashed filename.
If report files or templates cannot be found, return a specific error.
validations: Check if the template file or report file exists before processing.
conditions: Use different templates or report files based on locale settings.
system_behavior: System exports reports in specified format.
System manages fallback to default language if alternate is unavailable.
